summary: The PR addresses the NumPy 1.24 deprecation warnings by modifying how out-of-bound values are handled in the colormap. The proposed solution follows NumPy's recommendation and includes a new reproduction script.

issues.description: The new reproduction script does not follow the typical naming convention for test files in the project, which might confuse contributors familiar with the existing structure.
The new reproduction script lacks comments explaining the purpose of each test case, which could improve clarity for future maintainers.
